description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle-backed data tier to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including PostgreSQL-compatible schema and photo storage, and replace plaintext database credentials with Managed Identity authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC configuration, SQL, and BLOB data types, as well as plaintext database credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service, and Managed Identity provides passwordless authentication.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver and update Spring datasource and Hibernate dialect configuration for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle-specific schema and SQL, including photo BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea. Update datasource URLs to use the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint and replace plaintext database credentials with Managed Identity authentication.
